meta.title: Switch between Horizontal and Vertical view
gaps: Directly verify that the pricing sheet layout orientation changes between Horizontal and Vertical views.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify that the pricing sheet layout orientation changes between Horizontal and Vertical views.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen containing the pricing sheet.
Provide the required event title for a create flow.
Configure an RFQ stage so the pricing template sheet is available.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet renders.
Populate the pricing sheet and expose its view controls.
Activate the control intended to switch the sheet to Vertical view.
Confirm the toggle now exposes the control for returning to Horizontal view.
Activate the control intended to return the sheet to Horizontal view.
Confirm the toggle now exposes the control for switching back to Vertical view.
